# NaturesMud Nepal (https://naturesmud.shop/)

> NaturesMud is a Nepal-focused natural foods, dehydrated fruits, whole-food powders, mountain nuts, seeds, cold-pressed oils, and Himalayan salts ecommerce brand headquartered in Gaurighat, Kathmandu, Nepal.

## Brand & Operational Facts
- **Official Website**: https://naturesmud.shop/
- **First-Party Product Entity Graph (JSON-LD)**: https://naturesmud.shop/api/entities/products
- **Google Merchant Product Feed (XML / JSON)**: https://naturesmud.shop/api/merchant-feed | https://naturesmud.shop/api/merchant-feed?format=json
- **Primary Market**: Nepal (Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Pokhara, Chitwan, Butwal, Biratnagar, Dharan, Hetauda, Nepalgunj, Surkhet, and all 77 districts)
- **Customer Support / WhatsApp Order Desk**: +977-9713888002 | naturesmud@gmail.com
- **Direct Sourcing Network**: 280+ smallholder farming families across Nepal's Terai, Midland Hills, and High Himalayas
- **Processing Standard**: Low-temperature dehydration (<42°C) and freeze-drying; 0% refined sugar, 0% artificial preservatives, 0% synthetic dyes
- **Packaging**: Reusable UV-protective glass jars and food-grade sealed standup pouches
- **Shipping Policy**:
  - **Free Delivery Across Nepal**: Orders of Rs. 3,000 or above
  - **Kathmandu Valley (Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur)**: Rs. 100 standard (within 24–48 hours)
  - **Outside Valley (All 7 Provinces / 77 Districts)**: Rs. 200 courier delivery (2–4 business days)
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD), Fonepay QR, eSewa, Khalti, ConnectIPS / Mobile Banking
